hero.title: Your style already speaks for you. Learn to direct it.
hero.lede: AC Styling's school: the same method I use with my clients, in courses you take at your own pace.

mirror.title: If any of this sounds familiar
mirror.body: You buy something you loved in the shop and never wear it at home. Someone told you you're "warm-toned" and you never worked out what to do with that. You have clothes you like and clothes you wear, and almost nothing in the overlap.
mirror.close: It isn't a shortage of clothes. It's a shortage of criteria, and criteria can be taught.

method.title: Why it happens
method.cognition: Clothes don't only change how you're read. They change how you think. In a study by Adam and Galinsky at Northwestern, two groups wore the same white coat: the group told it was a doctor's coat showed better sustained attention. Same garment, different story, different performance.
method.thesis: So I don't teach trends. I teach you to decide: which colours hold you up, which silhouettes represent you, and what you want to communicate before you open the closet.

locate.title: Four seasons. Find yours.
locate.body: Your season isn't a box. It's a position between three things: temperature, value and intensity. The course takes you there with a method you can repeat on your own, in front of the mirror.
locate.splitBody: The twelve sub-seasons need real light and a trained eye, so I keep them for one-to-one analysis. It isn't a cut-down version of the method: it's honestly how far a course can take you.
locate.fieldAlt: A continuous colour field. Temperature runs warm to cool across the horizontal axis and value runs light to dark down the vertical. The four seasons — spring, summer, autumn and winter — appear as soft regions rather than boxes.

faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Do I need to know anything before I start?
faq.a1: No. The courses start from zero and each module builds on the one before.
faq.a2: About an hour per masterclass, split into short modules so you can take them one at a time.
faq.a3: You create your account at checkout and go straight into the Vault, in your browser. There's nothing to download.
faq.q4: How long do I keep it?
faq.a4: For life. No renewals, no monthly fee, no expiry date.
faq.a5: Every course is recorded in both Spanish and English. You choose inside the platform.
faq.q6: What can I watch it on?
faq.a6: Any browser: phone, tablet or computer.
faq.a7: Credit and debit card, through Stripe.
faq.q9: Does this replace working with you directly?
faq.a9: No, and it isn't meant to. The course gives you the criteria and takes you to your season. Working one to one settles your exact sub-season and your real closet. Plenty of clients do both, in that order.

closing.title: Your style is already saying something.
closing.body: Make it say it on purpose.
